    Coaching

    Professional Business Coaching with Falesha Raquel

    Coaching for ambitious entrepreneurs.

    Have a business idea? Let's bring it to life.

    Falesha helps entrepreneurs launch and establish a business from scratch. She offers a clear plan and practical support to people who have the vision but need guidance.

    Together you turn the idea into a business with a defined brand identity, a professional online presence and client tracking systems.

    Work with me ↗

    What is included

    Build your business foundation

    Business direction

    Clarify the idea, define your ideal client, shape the offer and plan the next steps.

    Incorporation help

    Guidance through incorporation and getting the basics of the business organized.

    Brand identity and logo

    A professional logo and a brand guide covering colors, fonts and visual direction.

    Website

    An online presence that explains your services and makes it easy to get in touch.

    CRM and client systems

    Organize leads, manage client information and set up follow-ups.

    Coaching and accountability

    Practical advice for decisions, launch tasks and steady progress.

    You bring the vision. Let's build the foundation.

    You do not need every detail defined at the start. Your starting point is assessed to work out the right support. To begin, press the button and describe your idea; the team will review it and discuss next steps.

    Work with me ↗
    Real estate coaching

    Join the Empire

    Partner with me at eXp Realty.

    Are you ready to join the Empire?

    Want personalized support to grow your brand, your business, your leads and your income? The form is confidential, no change is made to your current license, and a team member will contact you.

    Join here ↗

    How it works

    Support built around your goals

    Working with Falesha helps you reach your professional goals, including ambitious ones, and opens the door to travel. She sees her network of partners as a great wealth and makes it available to her team.

    • Weekly coaching
    • Monthly performance coaching
    • Social media support
    • Branding support
    • Transaction coordination
    • International opportunities
    • Marketing training

    The first step is writing a business plan and defining your brand. There is no one-size-fits-all plan: it is adapted to your goals, skills and availability. Success depends on action from you, with support all along the way.

    Getting started

    Four first steps

    1. Fill out the formThen schedule a call with Falesha and/or a team leader, or start the eXp onboarding process.
    2. Schedule a callBy Zoom or phone, to ask your questions.
    3. Start the license transferWith the onboarding team.
    4. OnboardingTwo more Zoom calls to set up email, business cards, kvCORE and Skyslope.
    FAQ

    Questions agents ask

    Can I be sponsored from outside my area?

    Yes. Your eXp sponsor does not need to be local, or in the same state or country. The sponsor and the broker are usually two different people; the broker is the one you are licensed under.

    How much does it cost to join?

    Canada: a $199 start-up fee, then $139 per month. Commission split 80/20 up to a $16,000 cap, then 100% for the rest of your anniversary year, less a $285 transaction fee. After $5,700 in capped transaction fees, $75 per transaction. A $29 broker review fee per transaction, and a $17 risk-management fee per transaction up to $200 per year.

    United States: a $149 start-up fee, then $85 per month. 80/20 split up to $16,000, then 100% less a $250 transaction fee. After $5,000 in capped fees, $75 per transaction. A $25 broker review fee per transaction, and a $40 risk-management fee per transaction up to $500 per year.

    New agents, or agents with fewer than three transactions in the last 12 months, take the eXpand mentorship program: a 60/40 split for the first three transactions with a certified mentor, then 80/20. Figures as shown on falesha.com; confirm with eXp before publishing.

    Will eXp honor my cap at my current brokerage?

    This is handled case by case. Fill out the request to receive the cap-carryover documents.

    Where is my office?

    Agents have access to more than 1,000 Regus offices worldwide. Your office is also anywhere you have a computer or mobile device with internet. Through eXp World and Workplace by Facebook you reach more than 500 employees, with real-time support more than 55 hours a week (transactions, technical, team services, operations, legal and accounting).

    Is eXp a fit for new agents?

    Yes, as long as the agent takes initiative, uses the tools and training (more than 50 hours of live training every week) and asks questions without waiting for step-by-step instructions.
